_comment: Copy to config/genai.json. Every text, decision and speech purpose runs on OpenAI (put OPENAI_API_KEY in .env at the repository root, or use "credential:NAME" for a systemd credential); every image is painted with ComfyUI behind the GPU broker (docs/gpu-broker.md), which must be running before a world is built. A purpose with no provider is simply off: worlds cannot be built without the world, image and check purposes, and people answer with simple stock replies without npc.decision.

openai._comment: Building worlds: Luna writes and plans; strict structured output enforces each answer's schema while decoding. 'flex' is half price; busy capacity is waited out.

openai-live._comment: Play-time calls (conversations, item legends): the standard tier, for low latency.

openai-decide._comment: OpenAI's decisions endpoint (/v1/decisions): checks of painted art and places.

openai-stt._comment: Speech to text for talking to people.

gpt-image._comment: GPT Image (list prices: text input $5, image input $8, image output $30 per million tokens; half through the Batch API). It paints the art (image.sprite, image.icon: transparent, at the least size, each round through the Batch API, about $0.003 an image), the animation (image.animation sheets and image.walk GIFs, always batched: about $0.026 per character that fights and $0.005 per townsperson for the sheets, plus $0.044 each for the walk GIFs) and reads the places (image.read: two plans per painting, about $0.06). Leave image.animation out to keep still images.

pocket._comment: Pocket TTS on this machine's CPU, in the game server on ONNX Runtime (packages/server/src/speech/pocket.ts): speaks every voice while the GPU is busy or away. It speaks with the models packages/server/speech/pocket_export.py exported to models/pocket in the repository (docs/hosting.md, step 4a; models names another folder). lines: lines spoken at once, each on threads threads; while lines due soon wait, it speaks with its small model (smallModel, default english_18m_2026-10; empty for none).

comfy._comment: The GPU broker in front of ComfyUI (production: the GPU PC's LAN address, with "apiKey": "credential:gpu-broker"). Places and every asset are painted with FLUX 3 Image Klein. Assets use the workflow below: Klein paints the subject on the chroma-key backdrop the prompt writer picked; the engine keys it out of the backdrop and scores the cut. Models: diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors, text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors, vae/flux2-vae.safetensors; reading places on the GPU (when image.read is left out) also needs Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (docs/places.md).

world.design._comment: Concept, world plan, story, places' plans and checks. strongModel (default gpt-6.1-sol, null turns it off) names each place's landmarks, at its list price ($2 input, $0.10 cached, $10 output per million tokens; flex halves them).

image.prompt._comment: Writes each asset's image prompt and picks its chroma-key backdrop (green, blue or magenta) and, for creatures, the view (front or side).

image.sprite._comment: Characters, creatures and objects by GPT Image 2.5 Flare (its batches came back in minutes where Sunburst's took up to an hour; docs/experiments/gpt-art). Klein is the backup: { "provider": "comfy", "width": 832, "height": 1216, "maxAttempts": 3 }.

image.icon._comment: Item icons by GPT Image; Klein backup: { "provider": "comfy", "width": 1024, "height": 1024, "maxAttempts": 2 }.

image.read._comment: Places read for walkable ground by two GPT Image plans (2.5 and 2.6 Sunburst), as accurate as Qwen with Luna (docs/experiments/gpt-read). Direct, since each painting's judging waits for it and Sunburst's batches took up to two hours; "batch": true halves its price (about $0.03 a painting). A Flare pair batches fast but read 1.7 points worse. Leave it out to read with Qwen on the GPU.

image.check._comment: Judges each painting's content (subject, framing, pose). The cut itself is scored without a model, against the known backdrop.

image.animation._comment: Characters' and creatures' animation frames (docs/world-art.md, Characters in motion), painted in the background after the art.

image.walk._comment: Walks painted as looping GIFs of eight frames by GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, one per painted view, through the Batch API (with image.animation on; the other clips stay sheets). About $0.044 per character. Leave it out to paint the walk in the sheets too.

spending._comment: OpenAI spending in dollars: the whole server's daily ceiling, and whether administrators are unlimited. Each player's monthly budget is set on their account (Users page, $10 by default). Providers may set "pricing": {"inputPerM", "cachedPerM", "outputPerM"}; OpenAI providers default to gpt-6-luna prices.
